lcc_original: 永恆主對該隱說：『你爲甚麼惱怒？你臉色爲甚麼變了呢？
notes: 耶和華 (UNV) → 永恆主 (LCC): both are renderings of the Tetragrammaton; <WH03068> attached to 永恆主 as the full divine-name phrase
發怒 (UNV, H02734 חרה) → 惱怒 (LCC): synonymous verbs for 'be angry/furious'; SN transferred directly
Second clause word order inversion: UNV has 你為甚麼…臉色 but LCC has 你臉色…爲甚麼; <WH06440> (פנים, face) moved to follow 臉色, and <WAH09001><WAH04100> moved to follow 爲甚麼, preserving semantic attachment
First clause 你<WAH09001>爲甚麼<WAH09001><WAH04100> mirrors UNV exactly (dual WAH09001 for the ל+מָּה prefix+root split); second clause 你 carries no tag, consistent with UNV's second-clause encoding
LCC omits 呢 after first question; no SN impact since 呢 is an unannotated Chinese aspect particle in both versions
